title: Makerspaces in India open to the public
description: Find public-access makerspaces and fabrication labs in India, with tools, access options and location links.
intro: Places where individuals can enquire about using shared tools, learn fabrication or join a making workshop. Public access can mean a paid pass, equipment booking or a course rather than unrestricted walk-in use. Confirm location, training, current fees and machine availability with each space. Map links are searches.

entries.name: Paper Crane Lab
entries.description: An appointment-only makerspace with tools for digital fabrication, electronics and hands-on making. The operator asks visitors to arrange a visit before buying a pass.
entries.address: 835, 10th Main Road, Water Tank Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: 3D printers, laser cutter, vinyl cutter, electronics and woodworking tools.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Hourly and multi-hour passes; 3D printing, laser use and materials have additional charges.

entries.name: Makers Adda — Jayanagar
entries.description: Param Foundation lists a public makerspace with fabrication and electronics facilities. Ask which equipment is available at this location and whether a tool induction is required.

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: 3D printers, laser cutter, mini CNC and electronics benches are listed for Makers Adda.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Daily and monthly passes are listed; materials are extra.

entries.name: FabLab Nagpur
entries.description: A community fabrication space offering daily and monthly access to work on projects. Ask which machines are available under the plan you choose.

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: Power tools and electronics workstations; 3D printing and laser cutting are listed with additional charges on the monthly plan.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Daily and monthly options; confirm training and machine charges.

entries.name: TinkerSpace
entries.description: TinkerHub describes TinkerSpace as open to people who want to learn and make. Its facilities include a maker station and 3D printing; ask about individual machine access before visiting.

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: Maker station and 3D printing; the operator also describes electronics and laser facilities.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: The space says people can walk in; check current machine access, training and any material charges.

entries.name: CSquare Innovation Lab — IIT Palakkad
entries.description: IIT Palakkad says its prototyping lab is open to the general public as well as its own community. Enquire about equipment booking and campus access before arriving.
entries.address: Nila Campus, IIT Palakkad, Kanjikode, Palakkad, Kerala 678623

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: CNC machines, laser cutters, 3D printers and hand tools.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Public users can enquire about booking; confirm access conditions and charges.

entries.name: Maker’s Asylum
entries.description: A community making space with a hands-on laser-cutting and 3D-printing workshop. The advertised workshop includes one month of space access; confirm dates and conditions before booking.

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: The workshop uses a laser cutter and 3D printer.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Workshop-linked access; general drop-in access is not confirmed.

entries.name: JMoon MakerSpace
entries.description: A robotics and electronics makerspace whose website describes day and longer memberships. Its information may be older; call before a first visit and confirm it is operating.
entries.address: A-51, 3rd Floor, Narang Colony, Janakpuri, New Delhi 110058

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: The operator describes robotics, electronics and 3D printing.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Day and weekend access are listed; confirm current availability and fees.

entries.name: CollabTherapy
entries.details: Design and prototyping space · New Delhi
entries.description: A co-design space listing access to a prototyping lab and fabrication resources. Confirm that the published address and passes are current before visiting.
entries.address: 420, Ave One, Westend Greens, Rangpuri, New Delhi 110037

facts.label: Equipment
facts.value: The operator lists 3D printing, laser cutting and CNC, charged separately.

facts.label: Access
facts.value: Day, week and month passes are listed; verify current plans.

ordering.explanation: Spaces are grouped alphabetically by city or town, then alphabetically by name within each location; this is not a quality ranking.
